suggestions.pitch: Jayden Daniels is projected for only 3.5 a week and does not start for me, while Hurts and Kittle give a 9-0 contender a big QB and TE upgrade from a team out of contention.
Meyers has scored 1.3 a week and never starts, so swap him to a rebuilding team for Kittle and Waller to fix my TE slot.
Etienne and Robinson are bench pieces for me, and Mahomes would upgrade QB for the playoff run.
